fr.sorbonne_u.components.plugins.asynccall

Class TailRecursiveCall

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Throwable
      • java.lang.Exception
        • fr.sorbonne_u.exceptions.VerboseException
          • fr.sorbonne_u.components.exceptions.BCMException
            • fr.sorbonne_u.components.plugins.asynccall.TailRecursiveCall
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable

    public class TailRecursiveCall
extends BCMException
    The class TailRecursiveCall implements a mean to pass an asynchronous call from the user code back to the plug-in implementation to forward it to another component in a tail recursive manner.

    Description

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       plugin != null
 invariant       tailRecursiveCall != null

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Created on : 2025-06-24

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant
